estimand: K-subset U-statistics from a fixed nmax-run pool with observed A8 run-label/rank prefix held fixed and only future runs drawn
fit_data: per-image A8 K<=4 labels and rank permutations
interpretation: Predictive realized-panel intervals conditional on parametric Dirichlet + class-race/rare-C model; not distribution-free identification intervals.
model: Dirichlet image posteriors + observed-rank-conditioned PL exponential spacings + S2 reference + rare-C tail sensitivity
model_comparison_lock: Use primary panel E0 and E1_CLIP predictive interval coverage counts; standardized residual tie-break. Secondary panels and race_tau1 are sensitivities.

prior_sensitivity.tail_warning: DAPS and FAST have zero C-over-G events in their A8 ranks

source_data_disclosure: No FFHQ K>4 or ImageNet phase-2 outcomes accessed before freeze.
uncertainty: Conditional panel noise + cluster bootstrap of model hyperparameters; model-conditional, not a partial identification interval

variant_comparison_rule.primary: For each family primary panel E0/E1_CLIP, count K grid points within [lo95,hi95]; tie-break by mean standardized residual
variant_comparison_rule.secondary_panels: Evaluate separately and do not pool with primary
variant_comparison_rule.sensitivity: race_tau1 is sensitivity, not an alternative retrospective primary model
variant_comparison_rule.tail: pooled 5/205 C-over-G all arise SITCOM; DAPS/FAST arms stress-only
